question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, for each security group that contains both DOWN ports and non-DOWN ports, show the security group ID, the total number of ports in the security group, the number of DOWN ports, the average running-sum (within the security group) of DOWN ports’ standard attribute IDs, the number of administratively UP ports that have at least one IP allocation, the average number of IP allocations per such administratively UP port, and the maximum number of subnet-id rows among those administratively UP ports. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT b.security_group_id, p.id AS port_id, p.status, p.admin_state_up, p.standard_attr_id
  FROM securitygroupportbindings b
  JOIN ports p ON p.id = b.port_id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
),
sg AS (
  SELECT security_group_id,
         COUNT(*) AS total_ports,
         SUM(status = 'DOWN') AS down_ports
  FROM base
  GROUP BY security_group_id

),

  SELECT security_group_id,

  FROM base
  WHERE status = 'DOWN'
),
down_avg AS (
  SELECT security_group_id, AVG(running_sum) AS avg_running_sum

  JOIN ports p ON p.id = b.port_id
  JOIN ipallocations a ON a.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
    AND p.admin_state_up = 1
  GROUP BY b.security_group_id, p.id
),
up_stats AS (
  SELECT security_group_id,
         COUNT(*) AS up_with_alloc,
         AVG(alloc_count) AS avg_alloc,

LEFT JOIN down_avg da ON da.security_group_id = sg.security_group_id

The running-sum of standard_attr_id for DOWN ports uses ORDER BY port_id within each security group, matching the historical pattern observed in program::a1047ad65318dcff863e76e7 and program::d6e7db6a2ce6230af5eea4c1.
The alloc CTE correctly joins ipallocations to ports and filters for admin_state_up = 1, grouping by security_group_id and port_id to get per-port allocation counts.
The up_stats CTE correctly aggregates over the alloc CTE to get the count of UP ports with allocations, average allocations per port, and max subnet_id rows.
The final SELECT correctly joins the three CTEs (sg, down_avg, up_stats) on security_group_id and returns all requested columns in the correct order.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT b.security_group_id, p.id AS port_id, p.status, p.admin_state_up, p.standard_attr_id
  FROM securitygroupportbindings b
  JOIN ports p ON p.id = b.port_id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
),
sg AS (
  SELECT security_group_id,
         COUNT(*) AS total_ports,
         SUM(status='DOWN') AS down_ports
  FROM base
  GROUP BY security_group_id
  HAVING SUM(status='DOWN') > 0 AND SUM(status<>'DOWN') > 0
),
down_run AS (
  SELECT security_group_id,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY security_group_id ORDER BY port_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum
  FROM base
  WHERE status = 'DOWN'
),
down_avg AS (
  SELECT security_group_id, AVG(running_sum) AS avg_running_sum
  FROM down_run
  GROUP BY security_group_id
),
alloc AS (
  SELECT b.security_group_id, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS alloc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.subnet_id) AS subnet_rows
  FROM securitygroupportbindings b
  JOIN ports p ON p.id = b.port_id
  JOIN ipallocations a ON a.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
    AND p.admin_state_up = 1
  GROUP BY b.security_group_id, p.id
),
up_stats AS (
  SELECT security_group_id,
         COUNT(*) AS up_with_alloc,
         AVG(alloc_count) AS avg_alloc,
         MAX(subnet_rows) AS max_subnet_rows
  FROM alloc
  GROUP BY security_group_id
)
SELECT sg.security_group_id,
       sg.total_ports,
       sg.down_ports,
       da.avg_running_sum,
       COALESCE(us.up_with_alloc,0) AS up_with_alloc,
       us.avg_alloc,
       us.max_subnet_rows
FROM sg
LEFT JOIN down_avg da ON da.security_group_id = sg.security_group_id
LEFT JOIN up_stats us ON us.security_group_id = sg.security_group_id
ORDER BY sg.security_group_id;

WITH port_sg AS (
  SELECT sgpb.security_group_id, p.id AS port_id, p.status, p.admin_state_up, p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
),
down_window AS (
  SELECT security_group_id,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY security_group_id ORDER BY port_id) AS running_sum
  FROM port_sg
  WHERE status = 'DOWN'
),
down_avg AS (
  SELECT security_group_id, AVG(running_sum) AS avg_running_sum
  FROM down_window
  GROUP BY security_group_id
),
port_ip AS (
  SELECT psg.security_group_id, psg.port_id,
         COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_alloc_count,
         COUNT(ia.subnet_id) AS subnet_id_count
  FROM port_sg psg
  LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON psg.port_id = ia.port_id
  WHERE psg.admin_state_up = 1
  GROUP BY psg.security_group_id, psg.port_id
),
admin_up_stats AS (
  SELECT security_group_id,
         COUNT(*) AS admin_up_with_ip_count,
         AVG(ip_alloc_count) AS avg_ip_alloc,
         MAX(subnet_id_count) AS max_subnet_id_count
  FROM port_ip
  WHERE ip_alloc_count > 0
  GROUP BY security_group_id
),
sg_counts AS (
  SELECT security_group_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS total_ports,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'DOWN' THEN port_id END) AS down_count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status <> 'DOWN' THEN port_id END) AS non_down_count
  FROM port_sg
  GROUP BY security_group_id
)
SELECT sc.security_group_id,
       sc.total_ports,
       sc.down_count,
       da.avg_running_sum,
       au.admin_up_with_ip_count,
       au.avg_ip_alloc,
       au.max_subnet_id_count
FROM sg_counts sc
LEFT JOIN down_avg da ON sc.security_group_id = da.security_group_id
LEFT JOIN admin_up_stats au ON sc.security_group_id = au.security_group_id
WHERE sc.down_count > 0 AND sc.non_down_count > 0
ORDER BY sc.security_group_id
